dashboard.title: BrandPulse Dashboard
dashboard.description: A brand health intelligence dashboard displaying KPIs, sentiment, awareness, competitor tracking, SEO performance, and AI-generated recommendations.

sections.title: Top KPI Cards
sections.description: Five animated metric cards at the top of the dashboard — one per brand health category. Each card counts up from zero on first render and shows a month-over-month delta.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Display name shown above the value.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Current numeric value of the metric.

fields.name: suffix
fields.description: Unit string appended to the value (e.g. '%', '/100', 'M').

fields.name: prefix
fields.description: String prepended to the value. Currently unused but supported.

fields.name: change
fields.description: Month-over-month percentage change. Positive = green arrow up, negative = red arrow down.

fields.name: icon
fields.description: Lucide icon component rendered inside the card badge.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Optional formatter applied to the value before display (e.g. toLocaleString for thousands separators).

sections.title: Mentions & Reach Trend
sections.description: Dual area chart showing total brand mentions and total audience reach over the last 7 months. Displayed as two overlapping gradient-filled areas.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Abbreviated month label used on the X-axis.

fields.name: mentions
fields.description: Total number of times the brand was mentioned across all monitored channels in that month.

fields.name: sentiment
fields.description: Overall sentiment score for the month (0–100). Stored but currently not plotted on this chart.

fields.name: reach
fields.description: Estimated total audience reached by brand mentions in that month (sum of follower/subscriber counts of posters).

sections.title: Sentiment Breakdown
sections.description: Donut chart showing the overall split of positive, neutral, and negative brand mentions.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Sentiment category label.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Percentage share of total mentions that fall into this sentiment category.

fields.name: color
fields.description: HSL color string used to fill the donut segment and the legend dot.

sections.title: By Channel
sections.description: Animated horizontal progress bars showing the percentage of brand mentions originating from each social/media channel.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Channel or platform name.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Percentage of total brand mentions from this channel.

sections.title: Brand Awareness
sections.description: Awareness funnel showing four stages from total target audience down to top-of-mind recall. Rendered as animated horizontal bars of decreasing width plus a three-stat summary row.
sections.visualization: Animated funnel bars (framer-motion) + summary stat tiles

fields.name: label
fields.description: Name of the funnel stage.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Percentage of the target population that falls into this awareness stage. Decreases as the funnel narrows.

fields.name: bar
fields.description: Tailwind CSS class applied to the animated bar to control its fill color/opacity.

sections.title: Brand Sentiment & Reputation
sections.description: Stacked horizontal bars showing positive, neutral, and negative sentiment percentages broken down by data source (social media, reviews, surveys, news).

fields.name: platform
fields.description: The data source from which sentiment was measured.

fields.name: positive
fields.description: Percentage of mentions/responses from this source classified as positive sentiment.

fields.name: neutral
fields.description: Percentage of mentions/responses from this source classified as neutral sentiment.

fields.name: negative
fields.description: Percentage of mentions/responses from this source classified as negative sentiment.

sections.title: Brand Usage & Consideration
sections.description: Grouped bar chart comparing the percentage of each age segment that currently uses the brand versus those who would consider purchasing in future.

fields.name: segment
fields.description: Age demographic segment displayed on the X-axis.

fields.name: usage
fields.description: Percentage of this age segment that currently uses the brand's products/services.

fields.name: consideration
fields.description: Percentage of this age segment that would consider purchasing the brand in the future.

sections.title: Brand Associations & Positioning
sections.description: Radar (spider) chart plotting your brand score against the top competitor across six brand attribute dimensions.

fields.name: attribute
fields.description: Brand attribute dimension shown on the radar axis label.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Score for BrandPulse (your brand) on this attribute, from consumer perception research.

fields.name: competitor
fields.description: Score for the top competitor on this attribute.

sections.title: Customer Loyalty & Advocacy
sections.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) panel showing the composite score, a color-coded stacked bar, and the underlying promoter / passive / detractor percentage breakdown.
sections.visualization: Large score display + stacked bar (inline CSS) + stat tiles

npsScore.description: Composite NPS = Promoters% − Detractors%. Ranges from −100 to 100. Displayed as the hero number.

npsBreakdown.name: value
npsBreakdown.description: Percentage of total survey respondents in this category.

npsBreakdown.name: color
npsBreakdown.description: HSL color used for this segment in the stacked bar.

sections.title: Competitor Tracking
sections.description: Three-part section: a multi-line brand score trend chart, a share-of-voice donut chart, and a full comparison table across all tracked competitors.

brand_score_trend.title: Brand Score Over Time
brand_score_trend.description: Line chart showing monthly brand score (0–100) for your brand and three competitors over seven months. Your brand is solid-lined; competitors use dashed lines.

fields.name: month
fields.description: Abbreviated month label for the X-axis.

fields.name: brandpulse
fields.description: BrandPulse brand score for this month.

fields.name: brandwatch
fields.description: Brandwatch brand score for this month.

fields.name: sprout
fields.description: Sprout Social brand score for this month.

fields.name: hootsuite
fields.description: Hootsuite brand score for this month.

share_of_voice.title: Share of Voice
share_of_voice.description: Donut chart showing each brand's proportion of total monitored mentions across all channels.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Brand name.

fields.name: value
fields.description: This brand's percentage of total cross-competitor mention volume.

fields.name: color
fields.description: HSL color used for this brand's donut segment and legend.

competitor_snapshot_table.title: Competitor Snapshot
competitor_snapshot_table.description: Side-by-side comparison table with one row per brand. The first row is always your own brand (highlighted with a 'You' badge).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Brand name.

fields.name: score
fields.description: Composite brand health score.

fields.name: mentions
fields.description: Total brand mentions in the current period.

fields.name: sentiment
fields.description: Positive sentiment percentage across all monitored sources.

fields.name: nps
fields.description: Net Promoter Score for this brand.

fields.name: awareness
fields.description: Aided brand awareness percentage among the target market.

fields.name: change
fields.description: Month-over-month change in brand score. Positive = improvement (green arrow up), negative = decline (red arrow down).

fields.name: color
fields.description: HSL color used as the brand's color indicator dot in the table and charts.

sections.title: SEO Performance
sections.description: Three-part section covering organic traffic trends, SEO health KPIs, and a ranked keyword table.

organic_traffic_trend.title: Organic Traffic Trend
organic_traffic_trend.description: Dual area chart splitting monthly organic sessions into branded (users who searched for your brand by name) and non-branded (users who found you via generic category keywords).

fields.name: month
fields.description: Abbreviated month label for the X-axis.

fields.name: branded
fields.description: Monthly organic sessions driven by branded search queries (e.g. 'BrandPulse', 'BrandPulse pricing').

fields.name: nonBranded
fields.description: Monthly organic sessions driven by generic/category search queries (e.g. 'brand tracking software').

seo_health_kpis.title: SEO Health
seo_health_kpis.description: Four static KPI cards summarising the brand's SEO authority and index footprint.
seo_health_kpis.visualization: Stat cards with icon, value, sub-label, and change badge

fields.name: domainAuthority
fields.description: Moz/Ahrefs-style domain authority score (0–100) indicating overall link equity and trustworthiness.

fields.name: backlinks
fields.description: Total number of referring domains linking to the site. Displayed in abbreviated form.

fields.name: keywordsInTop10
fields.description: Number of keywords for which the brand ranks in positions 1–10 on Google.

fields.name: indexedPages
fields.description: Total number of site pages currently indexed by Google.

top_keywords_table.title: Top Ranking Keywords
top_keywords_table.description: Table of the brand's highest-value ranking keywords, sorted by estimated organic traffic. Position badges are highlighted for top-3 rankings.
top_keywords_table.visualization: HTML table with position badge and directional change indicator

fields.name: keyword
fields.description: The search query for which the brand ranks.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Current Google organic ranking position (1 = top result). Positions 1–3 are highlighted in the UI.

fields.name: change
fields.description: Change in position since last period. Positive = moved up (improved), negative = moved down (declined), 0 = unchanged. Note: lower position number = higher ranking, so +3 means gained 3 spots.

fields.name: volume
fields.description: Average monthly Google search volume for this keyword.

fields.name: traffic
fields.description: Estimated monthly organic sessions driven by this keyword based on position CTR and search volume.

sections.title: Live Mentions
sections.description: Chronological feed of the most recent brand mentions detected across monitored platforms. Animated in staggered sequence on load.
sections.visualization: List of mention cards with platform avatar, sentiment badge, and truncated text

fields.name: platform
fields.description: Platform or channel where the mention was detected.

fields.name: user
fields.description: Username, handle, or display name of the person who made the mention.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Full text of the mention. Truncated with CSS ellipsis in the card.
fields.example: BrandPulse is revolutionizing how companies track their online reputation...

fields.name: sentiment
fields.description: AI-classified sentiment of the mention.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Human-readable relative timestamp of the mention.

sections.title: AI Recommendations
sections.description: Grid of AI-generated action cards ranked by priority. Clicking a card expands it and triggers a character-by-character typing animation on the description text.
sections.visualization: Expandable cards (framer-motion AnimatePresence) with typing effect

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Urgency level of the recommendation. Controls border color, badge color, and glow effect.

fields.name: icon
fields.description: Lucide icon rendered inside the priority badge.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short headline for the recommendation.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed explanation of the insight and recommended action. Revealed with a typing animation when the card is expanded.
fields.example: Tech influencer @sarahdev (450K followers) mentioned your product positively 2 hours ago...

fields.name: impact
fields.description: Projected impact metric displayed in the top-right corner of the card.

fields.name: impactColor
fields.description: Tailwind CSS class controlling the color of the impact label.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Label for the CTA button at the bottom of the card.
